video:video.video:description: Berlin Zoo's giant panda twins Leni and Lotti celebrated their second birthday with an ice cake made from frozen beetroot and carrot juice.

video:video.video:description: Prince Harry and six others, including Elton John, have been ordered to pay an initial 9.5 million pounds ($13 million) to the publisher of Britain’s Daily Mail newspaper following their failed invasion of privacy case.
